{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= GUI Control - Menu

|descr= Deletes menu entry on given path.

|s1= [[menuDelete]] [idc,path]

|p1= idc: [[Number]]

|p2= path: [[Tree View Path]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= control [[menuDelete]] path

|p21= control: [[Control]]

|p22= path: [[Tree View Path]]

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>(findDisplay 313 displayCtrl 120) menuDelete [1]; // removes the second entry from Eden Editor menu strip. Restart Eden Editor to reset the menu.</sqf>
